checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: dependency-free Python CLI expense ledger; package, storage, CLI and tests

impact_assessment.why: Bootstrap a complete, useful first project in the dedicated projects/ workspace
impact_assessment.benefits: Working add/list/summary expense tracker with atomic local JSON storage and a passing regression suite
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CLI and on-disk schema; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: advisory lock around read-modify-write; state: JSON ledger needs atomic write and backup
impact_assessment.mitigation: Document commands in README, one schema in storage module, <.lock> plus temp+fsync+replace and .bak, unit tests for every command and fault

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement package: models, atomic storage, ledger operations and CLI
[3/3] Docs and memory: README, ADR-001, gitignore; prepare Phase 4 gates
[3/3] Phase 4 passed: tests 25/25, hygiene, guidelines and secrets gates green; checklists: passed
